decision: Expose the existing shared input-access diagnostic from GNOME and KDE menus and startup recovery. Distinguish device permission denial, missing devices and verified native X11 session availability; request administrator repair only for an actual permission/uinput repairable condition.
reason: The previous missing-keyboard warning suggested permissions on a VNC-only machine without a physical keyboard. Menus lacked a discoverable shared diagnostic and KDE daemon control.
verification: Isolated diagnostic, Qt/GTK UI, installer and tray contract receipts are recorded in docs/development/input-access-recovery-2026-10-20.md and kde-install-control-2026-10-20.md. Native X11 readiness uses a bounded read-only daemon probe; that probe is not client acceptance.
not_tested: No permission or privileged repair is certified without an actual affected device. VNC client behavior is owned by the separate remote-X11 evidence document.
